Indian Outlets Focus on Unique Food Preparations and Recipes

Several Indian media outlets have published articles highlighting distinctive culinary methods and recipes. These include traditional tribal dishes, unique ways of preparing chickpeas using ingredients like Fuller's Earth and lime, and methods to achieve traditional flavors using modern appliances. The coverage emphasizes taste, health benefits, and ease of preparation.
